items.title: Understanding ChatGPT Work
items.summary: OpenAI于7月9日推出ChatGPT Work，分Work Cloud（云端）与Work Local（桌面版），仅对$20/月及以上订阅者开放。Work支持选择GPT-5.6 Sol/Luna/Terra与GPT-5.5模型，具备带互联网访问的代码执行环境（超越Chat的隔离环境及Claude受限域名单列）、无头Chrome浏览器、跨会话持久文件系统及发布ChatGPT Sites等能力。
items.summary_en: OpenAI launched ChatGPT Work on July 9th, a cloud-based product available exclusively to $20/month+ subscribers. It offers GPT-5.6 Sol, Luna, and Terra models with configurable reasoning levels, plus key capabilities absent from regular Chat: code execution with internet access, a headless Chrome browser, persistent filesystem, sub-agent sessions, and ChatGPT Site publishing. The internet-enabled code execution environment is highlighted as the most significant upgrade, exceeding Claude's restricted allowlist approach.

items.title: calesthio/OpenMontage
items.summary: OpenMontage 是全球首个开源的 agentic 视频制作系统，拥有 12 条生产管道、100+ 工具和 700+ agent skill 文件，可将 AI 编码助手升级为完整视频制作工作室。与主流"图片动画拼凑"方案不同，它通过构建免费素材库和开源档案库，检索真实
items.summary_en: OpenMontage is the world's first open-source, agentic video production system featuring 12 pipelines, 100+ tools, and 700+ agent skill files that turn an AI coding assistant into a full video studio. It produces actual motion videos—rather than just animating stills—by building corpora from free stock footage and open archives, then editing and rendering them via Remotion composition. Production costs demonstrated in examples range from $1.33 to $5, with capabilities spanning scriptwriting, asset generation, narration, and soundtrack integration.

items.title: abi/screenshot-to-code
items.summary: abi/screenshot-to-code 是一个开源工具，可将截图、Figma 设计稿和屏幕录制视频一键转换为干净的 HTML/Tailwind/React/Vue 代码，支持 GPT-5.5、Claude Opus 4.8、Gemini 3.1 Pro 等主流模型，并可在 screenshottocode.com 直接在线使用。
items.summary_en: Screenshot-to-Code is an AI-powered tool that converts screenshots, Figma designs, mockups, and screen recordings into clean, functional code in HTML/Tailwind, React, Vue, Bootstrap, or Ionic. It supports default models including Gemini 3 Flash/3.1 Pro Preview, GPT-5.5, GPT-5.4 Mini, Claude Opus 4.6/4.8, and z-image-turbo via Replicate. Users can access it through the hosted app at screenshottocode.com or run it locally with API keys from OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and Replicate.

items.title: addyosmani/agent-skills
items.summary: addyosmani/agent-skills 提供25个工程技能模块和9个slash命令，覆盖从定义需求到上线的完整开发流程（spec/plan/build/test/review/ship），支持Claude Code、Cursor、Codex等70+ AI编程助手。通过 `npx skills add addyosmani/agent-skills` 即可一键安装全部技能，或在Claude Code中使用 `/plugin marketplace add addyosmani/agent-skills` 进行原生集成。其核心设计是让AI代理自动根据任务类型触发对应技能，例如设计API时激活 api-and-interface-design 技能，一次审批计划后 `/build` 可自主完成所有编码任务，同时保留逐任务测试驱动和失败暂停机制。
items.summary_en: addyosmani/agent-skills provides production-grade engineering skills that encode senior developer workflows, quality gates, and best practices for AI coding agents across the Define, Plan, Build, Verify, Review, and Ship lifecycle. It includes nine slash commands (/spec, /plan, /build, /test, /constraints, /review, /webperf, /code-simplify, /ship) and installs into 70+ agents via `npx skills add addyosmani/agent-skills`, with native support for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, and Cline.

items.title: Show HN: Ration – see your Claude usage across terminals and brag usage
items.summary: Ration 是一款基于 Swift 的 macOS 菜单栏应用（brew install solodynamo/ration/ration），可实时追踪 Claude Code 使用量并生成可视化报告。它通过读取本地会话日志实现 100% 本地运行，无需网络调用，支持按项目和分支统计用量、展示 7 天趋势以及生成含费用估算的可分享总结卡片。需 macOS 13+ 和 Xcode 16 / Swift 6 环境。
items.summary_en: Ration is a tiny native macOS menu-bar app (available via `brew install solodynamo/ration/ration` or .dmg) that visually tracks Claude Code API usage against an auto-calibrated budget, with breakdowns by project and branch, 7-day trends, and shareable recap cards. It runs 100% locally by reading Claude Code's session logs off disk—no accounts, no network calls—requiring macOS 13+ and Xcode 16/Swift 6 to build. Its provider-agnostic design allows easy extension to support additional LLM tools via new `UsageProvider` conformances.

items.title: 陶哲轩：100年后，数学再度大危机！
items.summary: 菲尔兹奖得主陶哲轩在论文《AI时代的数学》中指出，10道研究级数学难题中4个前沿AI系统答对了7道，成本仅几十到几百美元，引发数学界堪比1920年代基础危机的新动荡。他提出"证明消化不良"概念——AI生成证明的速度远超人类验证、评审和消化的速度，并主张作者若无法清晰讲解成果就不应发表，同时引用《莱顿宣言》强调人类须为最终成果负责。
items.summary_en: Fields Medalist Terence Tao presented a paper arguing that frontier AI systems can solve at least 7 out of 10 open research-level math problems for just tens to hundreds of dollars — tasks that might take a PhD student years. He warns that mathematics faces a new "proof indigestion" crisis: AI can now generate proofs faster than the academic community can verify, digest, and integrate them into established theory. Tao proposes a five-level quality pipeline (solving → formal verification → clear human-understandable exposition → peer acceptance → textbook-classicization) and insists that if a result cannot be clearly explained by its author, it should not be published, even with AI-assisted formal verification.

items.title: 造物 100 #04｜AI 为爱做「鸭」、PLAUD 又推新作、字节 TRAE 造了个数字工牌
items.summary: Hugging Face 发布 Microduck 开源鸭子机器人（25厘米/800克，399美元，15个电机+强化学习训练，圣诞发货）；Plaud 推出 Plaud One AI 录音耳机（249.99美元，充电盒内置 eSIM+4G，25-30小时录音，已售出超100万台同类设备）。Autonomous.ai 发布桌面机器人台灯（499美元，人脸追踪、驼背提醒、70+技能商店，跑在开源 Autonomous OS 上）；CodeeBot 编程积木（299-799美元，GPT 语音家教，已进入湖北中小学课堂）；TRAE 联名 FoloToy AI Passport 徽章（39.99美元，微信小程序同步，支持 AI 编程 DIY
items.summary_en: Hugging Face launched Microduck, a 25cm open-source reinforcement-learning robot duck priced at $399, aiming to become the entry point for a robotics developer ecosystem. Meanwhile, Plaud released its AI recording earbuds Plaud One ($249.99) with a SIM-embedded charging case serving as the main computer, and FoloToy teamed with ByteDance's TRAE to launch a $39.99 AI-powered open-hardware badge where users can AI-code their own apps via TRAE or Claude Code without writing code themselves. The broader trend shows software companies entering affordable, DIY-friendly AI hardware to capture long-term subscription revenue rather than relying on high-margin device sales.

items.title: kaifcodec/user-scanner
items.summary: user-scanner 是一个由 kaifcodec 开发的开源 OSINT 情报收集工具，支持对单个邮箱或用户名在 455+ 活跃扫描节点（175+ 邮箱平台 / 280+ 用户名平台）上进行账号注册探测与元数据抓取。核心能力包括 --cross-scan 跨节点 Pivoting 引擎（自动从邮箱挖取用户名、从用户名反向关联邮箱）、MCP Server 原生集成（对接 Claude Desktop / Cursor / Antigravity 等 AI Agent）、以及 Hudson Rock 信息窃取器泄露情报查询（--hudson 标志）。安装方式为 `pip install user-scanner`，典型用法为 `user-scanner -u johndoe` 或 `user-scanner -e email@example.com --cross-scan`，支持并行高并发扫描与 PDF/JSON/CSV 多格式导出。
items.summary_en: user-scanner is a 2-in-1 OSINT toolkit that scans 455+ platforms (175+ email-integrated sites and 280+ username platforms) from a single email or username input. It features cross-scan pivoting, rich metadata scraping, MCP server integration for AI agents like Claude Desktop and Cursor, and Hudson Rock breach intelligence via the --hudson flag. The tool can be installed via pip (`pip install user-scanner` or `pip install "user-scanner[mcp]"`) or Nix, and generates reports in PDF, JSON, and CSV formats.

items.title: Show HN: Automated Sanborn map georeferencing, with a Chicago map viewer
items.summary: 该工具实现了Sanborn地图的自动化地理配准，并提供了芝加哥地图查看器功能。用户可以通过autogeoref.com访问该在线服务。
items.summary_en: The project automates the georeferencing of Sanborn fire insurance maps and provides an interactive Chicago map viewer at autogeoref.com. It was shared on Hacker News, where it received 2 points and 1 comment.

items.title: No AI Fridays
items.summary: HTMX CEO @lazilyevaluated 发起"No AI Fridays"倡议，建议每周有一天完全关闭AI助手，手动编写代码、阅读文档并自主思考。这样做可减少LLM带来的认知债务、保持对决策方向的控制，同时让greptile、prelint等工具为手工代码提供可学习的反馈。
items.summary_en: "No AI Fridays" advocates dedicating one day weekly to working without AI to combat cognitive debt, preserve critical thinking, and reduce token costs. The CEO of HTMX has mandated this practice and invites other companies to join the initiative by contacting @lazilyevaluated. AI feedback tools like Greptile and Prelint are still encouraged for learning from handcrafted code.

items.title: 索尼与华纳起诉Anthropic，指控其大规模盗用版权音乐训练Claude
items.summary: 索尼音乐和华纳音乐等出版商在加州北区联邦法院对Anthropic及CEO达里奥·阿莫代伊、联合创始人本杰明·曼个人提起诉讼，指控其未经许可从盗版图书馆LibGen和PiLiMi种子下载至少700万本书籍，并抓取MusixMatch和LyricFind等平台歌词用于训练Claude模型。原告要求每件被侵权作品最高赔偿15万美元，非法删除版权管理信息每次最高赔偿2.5万美元。此案瞄准Anthropic在2025年9月以15亿美元和解的同类软肋——非法下载行为本身即构成独立侵权。
items.summary_en: Sony Music and Warner Music have filed a 48-page lawsuit in Northern California federal court against Anthropic and its CEO Dario Amodei and co-founder Benjamin Mann personally, alleging the company illegally downloaded and used tens of thousands of copyrighted musical compositions—primarily song lyrics—to train its Claude models without permission. The plaintiffs are seeking up to $150,000 per infringed work and up to $25,000 per violation for unlawful removal of copyright management information. The case centers on Anthropic's data acquisition methods—torrenting from pirate libraries LibGen and PiLiMi, scraping licensed platforms MusixMatch and LyricFind, and using synthetic data generated by models trained on pirated content—which mirrors the strategy that previously forced Anthropic's record $1.5 billion copyright settlement in September 2025 over pirated books.

items.title: 派早报：GTA 6 引发请假玩游戏热潮
items.summary: 《侠盗猎车手6》将于11月19日发售，系列累计销量近4.75亿套，第二支预告片首日播放量近
items.summary_en: GTA 6 launches November 19, driving a请假 surge among players; the franchise has sold nearly 475 million copies lifetime, and its second trailer hit nearly 500 million views on day one. Meanwhile, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman partnered with Swiss watchmaker Vanguart to produce 7 custom titanium Orb watches starting at $180,000, etched with AI-themed inscriptions including "COMPUTE IS DESTINY" and a Python AGI-alignment prompt. In security news, GrapheneOS may abandon Pixel 11 support after Google removed ARM MTE hardware memory safety features across software, firmware, and hardware layers.
